taxonomic_note: Current Kew/POWO treatment accepts Argythamnia aphoroides; Ditaxis aphoroides is retained as a homotypic synonym.
look_here_first: Start with sessile leaves and a 3–8 cm axillary inflorescence. The strongest split from A. simulans is that A. aphoroides inflorescences are unisexual; then confirm with 10 stamens and a relatively large 7–9 mm woolly capsule.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Deep Review B independently documented Hays, Comal, and Bexar using federal/TPWD-linked county evidence.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Edwards Plateau habitat is supportive context only; the PASS uses exact county records.

best_field_traits: limestone-derived Edwards Plateau grassland/open oak-juniper habitat
small unisexual flowers in axillary racemes
proximal pistillate and distal staminate flowers
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Separate from A. humilis and A. simulans with inflorescence, flower, capsule, and seed characters; habit and habitat alone are not secure.
morphology_keys.staminate_flower: Sepals 4–5.5 mm; petals 3.3–4 mm, free from androphore; 10 stamens; 0 staminodes
morphology_keys.pistillate_flower: Sepals 6–7 mm; styles 1.5–3 mm, tomentose; stigmas flattened
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Capsules 7–9 mm, tomentose to lanulose; seeds 3.7–5 mm, smooth to lightly tuberculate or striate

comparisons.key_distinctions: Reproductive architecture and fruit/seed characters should drive identification rather than general low stature or limestone habitat.

photo_note: Final diagnostic flower/fruit image selection and image-specific license verification remain later polish.

fastest_traits: Staminate flowers with 10 stamens and no staminodes

look_alikes.distinction: A. humilis has a 2–10 mm petiole and extremely short 0.7–0.9 cm raceme; its capsules and seeds are much smaller.
Both are sessile and long-racemed. A. aphoroides has unisexual inflorescences and 10 stamens; A. simulans has bisexual inflorescences and 7–8 stamens.

diagnostic_photo_targets: Unisexual raceme showing one sex only
Mature 7–9 mm woolly capsule with scale
